title: CoastCAD Vendor Email: Mobile Subscription Renewal Reminder, 13:38

fields.subject: FRIENDLY REMINDER: CoastCAD Mobile Renewal, Contract MC-2026-114
fields.body:
Hi Marlow County Communications team,

FRIENDLY REMINDER: Your CoastCAD Mobile annual subscription (Contract MC-2026-114) expires 30 April 2027.

To avoid interruption of mobile data terminals, please return the signed renewal and the updated position count for your backup center by Friday, April 16. I've attached the renewal form and a position count worksheet. If your backup positions have changed since last year, list them there so we can adjust your license tier.

Reply to this email to schedule your 30-minute renewal call! I have openings Thursday and Friday afternoon.

Thanks for being a valued CoastCAD partner!
fields.signature:
Megan Holloway
Account Manager, Pacific Northwest Public Safety
CoastCAD Systems
503-555-0147

instructorNote: This is a noise item: a software renewal notice from the CAD vendor, not part of the county's warning communications (MarlowAlert, the Wireless Emergency Alert system, sirens, the county website and the radio simulcast). The 911 Supervisor parks it and keeps staff on call triage.
